value.signature: fn key_integer (& self , at : usize) -> Option < i128 >

exception.justification: Justified: Location inspection borrows an already published audit outcome.

review.body: { match self . kinds . get (at) ? { LocationKind :: UnsignedInteger => self . slots . get (at) . copied () . map (i128 :: from) , LocationKind :: SignedInteger => self . slots . get (at) . copied () . map (| value | i128 :: from (i64 :: from_ne_bytes (value . to_ne_bytes ()))) , _ => None , } }
review.item_premise: The published audit location exposes only its fixed tag and already retained scalar key; inspection does not read or allocate store state.
